text: 10 OVERDOSAGE The maximum dose of vardenafil for which human data are available is a single 120 mg dose of the film–coated tablets administered to eight healthy male volunteers. The majority of these subjects experienced reversible back pain/myalgia and/or “abnormal vision.” In cases of overdose, standard supportive measures should be taken as required. Renal dialysis is not expected to accelerate clearance because vardenafil is highly bound to plasma proteins and is not significantly eliminated in the urine.
